name: tht-radial
title: Radial through-hole part
summary: Radial lead part: a round body standing on its standoff on two straight round leads, a marking plane on its top (lead_pitch, lead_diameter, lead_below, standoff, root, body_diameter, body_height, top_round).
provenance: Original work: the in-code through-hole builder's construction (crates/solidcraft-integration/src/models/tht.rs, retired with this file) authored through SolidCraft's commands over plain parameters by `cargo test -p sparksmith-solidcraft --test author_parts -- --ignored` (saved at Ø5 × 11 mm, leads 0.5 mm at 2 mm); the tht generator gives every value. Estimated lead roots, bends and rounds; no vendor drawing or EDA/CAD library data copied.
